description.value: Kempf Orchards is a family-run U-pick cherry orchard in Kelowna's Okanagan region, with an orcharding tradition going back to 1966. Cyclists passing through during cherry season can pick their own fresh cherries directly from the trees, choosing from several varieties including Rainier, Lapins, and Sour cherries. The orchard is a beloved local summer destination and a genuine taste-of-place stop on any Okanagan tour.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a seasonal U-pick cherry orchard operating in Kelowna's Okanagan region, with a family tradition dating to 1966. No bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site. The site does announce that the kempforchards.com website will go offline after July 1, 2026, with future updates via Facebook and Instagram only, which is a near-term concern given today's date of 2026-05-28.
concerns: Website announces it will go permanently offline after July 1, 2026 — the listing URL will be dead within weeks; future updates only via Facebook and Instagram.
No phone number available in OSM tags or on the website.
Highly seasonal operation (cherry season only); not a year-round resource for cyclists.
Website does not confirm the street address 1409 Teasdale Road explicitly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A genuine fruit-at-source stop for touring cyclists in the Okanagan; fresh-picked cherries are a notable and useful resupply for riders passing through Kelowna during summer season.
enrichment_extras.notes: Payment is cash or debit only. Pets not allowed in picking areas. Maximum occupancy applies; wait times possible at peak season.

wow_evidence: family-run U-pick cherry orchard... orcharding tradition going back to 1966
